data.name: Dayniyah
data.gender_notes: Dayniyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'daina' which means 'gentle' or 'sweet'. In Islamic tradition, Dayniyah is a beautiful name for a girl symbolizing kindness and sweetness. The name Dayniyah carries the meaning “Gentle, Sweet” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dayniyah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, sweet and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a beloved child of Allah, evoking feelings of tenderness, care, and protection.
data.etymology: Dayniyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Sweet.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dayniyah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: دَيْنِيَّة
in_arabic.long_meaning: دَيْنِيَّة هي اسم مؤنث مشتق من الملك والسيادة والسلطان، ويحمل هذا الاسم معنىً عميقاً من الناحية الدينية والثقافية، حيث يشير إلى الشخص الذي يملك الصفات الملكية والقيادية والسيادية، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في التاريخ الإسلامي لوصف الشخصيات القيادية والملوك الصالحين

in_urdu.name: دینیہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: دینیہ ایک عربی نام ہے جو ملکیت اور سلطنت کی مالک کے معنی میں ہے، یہ نام برصغیر پاک و ہند میں بھی استعمال ہوتا ہے، اور اس کا استعمال مسلم ثقافت میں ایک خاص مقام رکھتا ہے، یہ نام ان لوگوں کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنے اعمال اور کردار سے دوسروں کو راہ دکھاتے ہیں

in_hindi.name: दैनिया
in_hindi.long_meaning: दैनिया एक अरबी नाम है जो राजा और सultan की मालकिन के अर्थ में है, यह नाम भारतीय मुसलमान समुदाय में भी उपयोग किया जाता है, और इसका उपयोग मुस्लिम संस्कृति में एक विशेष स्थान रखता है, यह नाम उन लोगों के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है जो अपने कार्यों और व्यवहार से दूसरों को मार्गदर्शन करते हैं

in_pashto.name: دینیہ
in_pashto.long_meaning: دینیہ د اراپي نوم دی چې پاچا او سلطنت مشرقة په معنی کیږي، دا نوم په افغانستان او پښتنو کې هم کارول کیږي، او دا نوم د مسلم کلچر کی یو ځانگړی مقام لري، دا نوم هغو کسانو لپاره کارول کیږي چې د خپلو کړو او چلند له لارې بلو ته لار ښیي

historical_references.reference: Dayniyah was the capital city of the Lakhmid Kingdom, located in present-day eastern Syria and western Iraq. The city was a significant cultural and religious center for the early Islamic period, and was noted for its beautiful gardens and learning institutions. The Lakhmid dynasty ruled the region from 383 to 602 AD, making Dayniyah an important city during the late Antiquity and early Islamic periods.

historical_references.reference: Dayniyah is also known as Al-Anbar in modern times, and was an important trading center during the Umayyad Caliphate. The city was a major stop on the caravan routes between Syria and Iraq, and was known for its production of dates and other agricultural products. The Umayyad Caliphate ruled the region from 661 to 750 AD, making Dayniyah an important city during the Islamic Golden Age.
